title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Wed 28 Oct
summary: A flat day (forecast flat). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:30 to about 17:45. A low day for October: the base stayed down near 3,000 ft (normal 4,500–5,400 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 3,900 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 3,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, 900 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 3,800 ft, off by 800 ft. Most of the day the shear line was at Pukalani; furthest south about 16:22, crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Upper Kahikinui stopped at 13:50; Kahikinui stopped at 13:55; Kaonoulu 1 stopped at 15:26; Waihou Springs 1 stopped at 15:26; the Mesonet could not be reached on 15 of 51 updates.
